syllabus_topics: Texts dealing with the most important topics for FMPI majors combining grammar revision with vocabulary needed to pass the A4 English exam.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum of 65 percent of the total points for the assigned work is needed. Points can be awarded for attendance, completed homework tasks, and short tests assigned during the course. The grading scale is A (100-93%), B (92-85%), C (84-77%), D (76-70%), E (69-65%).
bibliography: Study materials are created by the teacher and available in electronic form.
Raymond Murphy: Essential Grammar in USe, Cambridge University Press, 1998
Michael McCarthy, Felicity O'Dell: English Vocabulary in Use, Cambridge University Press, 1994
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
